name: Keeper Bel'varil
summary: At Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil studies magic and alchemy for the Forsaken. His work with Wordeen Voidglare draws Horde adventurers into the search for relics and binding materials across Hillsbrad Foothills.

sections.title: Study in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Keeper Bel'varil supports Forsaken magic and alchemy in besieged Tarren Mill. The royal apothecaries and soldiers focus on the Alliance garrison down the road at Southshore. Bel'varil turns to practical sorcery, sending travelers to recover stone tokens and binding bracers from nearby elemental and enchanted threats.

faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil studies magic in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He works with fellow researcher Wordeen Voidglare to examine magical artifacts and reagents found across the contested territory.

faq.q: Where can I find Keeper Bel'varil?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil stands in Tarren Mill, the Forsaken settlement in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What tasks does Keeper Bel'varil offer?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil sends Horde adventurers to collect magical remnants, including stone tokens and bracers of binding. He studies them to understand and manipulate elemental forces.

angles.text: As a Horde champion in Hillsbrad Foothills, you can aid Bel'varil by subduing elemental threats and recovering binding charms. He offers practical rewards for this work.
As Forsaken, you share Bel'varil's pursuit of arcane mastery and resourcefulness. His careful study of regional relics seeks an edge for your people in Lordaeron.
